attributes.title: MITRE - Gap legend
attributes.visState:
{"title": "MITRE - Gap legend", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "#### Detection-gap reading
This rule catalog defines **215 MITRE technique tags** across ~100 unique techniques (Windows + Linux + Appliances). This view aggregates every platform (no filter).

- **Coverage metric** = distinct techniques/tactics that have *actually fired* in-window.
- A catalog technique **absent** from *Top techniques* = either a **quiet environment** or a **broken/dead rule** — cross-check against the **Detection Health** dashboard's "custom rules that fired" panel to tell them apart.
- **Severity-weighted** bar surfaces techniques whose few hits are high-impact (sum of rule.level)."}}
